text:
Marta L: Heads up — p95 on /generate spiked ~120ms around 12:10UTC after a quota fallback. Console shows sample_origin="combined". Anyone see retries being counted into the endpoint rollup?

Josh C: I think retries are tagged transport=retry, but our rollup can collapse labels. cc @Samir

Samir: Quick question — the metrics query on the dashboard, is it using include_retries=true? That would inflate p50/p95 if retry includes backend wait. Can you paste the query?

Marta L: Yep:
```
metrics.query('latency', { endpoint: '/generate', window: '5m', include_retries: true, merge_mode: 'rollup' })
```

Preeti: If retries are instrumented as separate samples with the same endpoint tag they end up in the same aggregation. We usually dedupe by request_id when computing percentiles — is dedupe enabled for this endpoint?

metrics-bot: Alert: quota-fallback-events increased 4x at 12:09UTC -> routing changed to eu-fallback-2 pool.

Josh C: Routing change could move traffic to a pool with a different kernel path / kvcache state and add ~80–150ms tail. Combined with retries that would explain the p95 bump.

Marta L: I'm going to toggle include_retries=false in the console to confirm. Repro plan: run a short synthetic load hitting /generate with tokenized prompts and fallback enabled.

Samir: Also check whether kvcache_hit tag is preserved across the fallback route; a cold kv hit after routing will blow up tail numbers.

Preeti: Short-term mitigation: set console default for percentile derivation to exclude retries for endpoints annotated with quota-fallback. Long term: add request_id dedupe in rollup mode=endpoint.

Marta L: Toggled include_retries=false — p95 dropped ~90ms. Screenshot uploaded: https://redwood.internal/s/shot/4954

Josh C: Nice. That confirms it. Can we add an annotation on the rollout explaining that fallback pools may be counted in endpoint rollups and can affect percentiles?

Samir: I'll open a tiny PR to the metrics backend to respect request_id-based dedupe when rollup_mode=endpoint. Will include unit test. PR link when ready.

Preeti: Also adding a small tooltip in the Console UI: "Percentiles may include retries and fallback routing; toggle 'include retries' to compare." Should be 2–3 lines + example query.

Marta L: :thumbsup: Thanks all. Follow-ups: 1) Console tooltip (Preeti), 2) backend dedupe PR (Samir), 3) rollout annotation + doc note (Josh). I'll file the three issues and link them here.

Josh C: If anyone wants to triage impact by customer tier, we can run the same compare by route weight and quota windows. Might reveal which tenants saw user-visible latency.

Marta L: Good call. I'll add a cohort compare to the ticket.

metrics-bot: Note: next scheduled rollout to eu-fallback-2 at 13:00UTC — watch p95 after deploy.

Preeti: Cool. If the backend change lands, let's also add a dashboard test that asserts p95 delta when include_retries toggled is within expected bounds.

Samir: On it — will include regression CI for rollup dedupe.

Marta L: Thanks team, closing the loop once patches are up.
